-- Step 1: Create index (run once)
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm;

-- Create a GIN index for the non-SARGable LIKE search
CREATE INDEX idx_gin_ci_note ON cast_info USING gin (note gin_trgm_ops);

-- Create indexes on foreign keys to improve join performance
CREATE INDEX idx_mc_movie_id ON movie_companies(movie_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_ci_movie_id ON cast_info(movie_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_ci_role_id ON cast_info(role_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_mc_company_id ON movie_companies(company_id);


-- Step 2: Run the optimized query
WITH actor_role AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM role_type
  WHERE role = 'actor'
),
russian_companies AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM company_name
  WHERE country_code = '[ru]'
)
SELECT MIN(chn.name) AS character,
       MIN(t.title) AS russian_mov_with_actor_producer
FROM title AS t
JOIN movie_companies AS mc ON t.id = mc.movie_id
JOIN russian_companies AS rc ON mc.company_id = rc.id
JOIN cast_info AS ci ON t.id = ci.movie_id
JOIN actor_role AS ar ON ci.role_id = ar.id
JOIN char_name AS chn ON chn.id = ci.person_role_id
JOIN company_type AS ct ON ct.id = mc.company_type_id
WHERE t.production_year > 2010
  AND ci.note LIKE '%(producer)%';
